app_act_desc_letters.ha: Herufi. Hapa tutajifunza herufi za Kiingereza.
app_act_desc_letters.en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

app_act_desc_quiz.ha: Tafuta picha. Jina la kitu litatajwa, kisha bonyeza picha yake.
app_act_desc_quiz.en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

app_act_desc_spell.ha: Kuandika. Hapa tutajifunza kuandika maneno ya Kiingereza, herufi kwa herufi.
app_act_desc_spell.en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

app_act_pick.ha: Chagua somo moja, ili usikie zaidi kuhusu somo hilo.
app_act_pick.en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

app_board_intro.ha: Hizi hapa ni herufi zote. Tujifunze kikundi kwa kikundi.
app_board_intro.en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

app_cat_desc_animals.ha: Wanyama. Somo hili linahusu wanyama mbalimbali wanaoishi karibu nasi.
app_cat_desc_animals.en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

app_cat_desc_body.ha: Mwili. Somo hili linahusu sehemu mbalimbali za mwili wa binadamu.
app_cat_desc_body.en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

app_cat_desc_food.ha: Chakula. Somo hili linahusu vyakula mbalimbali tunavyokula kila siku.
app_cat_desc_food.en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

app_cat_desc_home.ha: Vitu vya nyumbani. Somo hili linahusu vitu tunavyotumia nyumbani.
app_cat_desc_home.en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

app_cat_desc_nature.ha: Mazingira. Somo hili linahusu vitu vya asili na mazingira yetu.
app_cat_desc_nature.en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

app_cat_desc_vehicles.ha: Magari. Somo hili linahusu magari na vyombo vingine mbalimbali tunavyopanda.
app_cat_desc_vehicles.en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

app_cat_start_animals.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za wanyama. Tutajifunza majina yao kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_animals.en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_body.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za sehemu za mwili. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_body.en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_food.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za vyakula. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_food.en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_home.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za vitu vya nyumbani. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_home.en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_nature.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za vitu vya asili. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_nature.en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_numbers.ha: Sasa tutajifunza kuhesabu. Utaonyeshwa vidole vya mkono. Hesabu vidole vilivyoinuliwa, kisha sema namba kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_numbers.en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

app_cat_start_vehicles.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za magari na vyombo vya usafiri. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
app_cat_start_vehicles.en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

app_quiz_tap.en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

app_quiz_wrong.ha: Hapana, si hiyo. Sikiliza tena, kisha jaribu tena.
app_quiz_wrong.en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

app_read_good.en: Well done! Now you can read!

app_read_intro.ha: Hili hapa ni neno. Tutasoma neno hili pamoja. Herufi kwa herufi.
app_read_intro.en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

app_read_word.ha: Sasa, soma neno zima kwa sauti kubwa.
app_read_word.en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

app_spell_intro.ha: Sasa, liandike kwa Kiingereza. Kuna njia mbili.
app_spell_intro.en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

app_spell_ord_1.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya kwanza.
app_spell_ord_1.en: Tap or say the first letter.

app_spell_ord_2.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya pili.
app_spell_ord_2.en: Tap or say the second letter.

app_spell_ord_3.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya tatu.
app_spell_ord_3.en: Tap or say the third letter.

app_spell_ord_4.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya nne.
app_spell_ord_4.en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

app_spell_ord_5.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya tano.
app_spell_ord_5.en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

app_spell_ord_6.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya sita.
app_spell_ord_6.en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

app_spell_ord_7.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya saba.
app_spell_ord_7.en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

app_spell_ord_8.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya nane.
app_spell_ord_8.en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

app_spell_ord_9.ha: Bonyeza au sema herufi ya tisa.
app_spell_ord_9.en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

app_spell_way_speak.en: Press Laila and say the letter.

app_stage_done.en: Well done! You've finished this group.

app_w_menu_intro.ha: Haya hapa ni masomo mbalimbali. Bonyeza picha yoyote ili ujue kuna nini ndani yake.
app_w_menu_intro.en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

app_w_spell_test.ha: Sasa, mtihani! Andika kila moja, herufi kwa herufi.
app_w_spell_test.en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

app_z_speak.ha: Wakati wowote unapotaka kuzungumza, bonyeza Laila. Nitasikiliza kwa makini!
app_z_speak.en: Whenever you want to speak, press Laila. I'll listen carefully!

s0.ha: Hujambo! Kama wewe ni msichana, bonyeza rangi nyeupe. Kama wewe ni mvulana, bonyeza rangi nyekundu.
s0.en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

s_abc_say.ha: Bonyeza Laila, kisha sema herufi unayoiona.
s_abc_say.en: Press Laila, then say the letter you see.

s_act_desc_things.ha: Vitu. Hapa tutajifunza majina ya vitu kwa Kiingereza, kwa kutumia picha.
s_act_desc_things.en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

s_all_done.ha: Hongera! Sasa unajua herufi zote na maneno yote.
s_all_done.en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

s_alone2.ha: Kuna mtu karibu nawe. Tafadhali, kaa peke yako mbele ya kamera.
s_alone2.en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

s_back_m.ha: Ili kurudi nyuma, bonyeza mlango huu.

s_back_f.ha: Ili kurudi nyuma, bonyeza mlango huu.

s_cat_desc_actions.ha: Vitendo. Somo hili linahusu mambo tunayofanya kila siku. Kama kula, kunywa, kukimbia na kucheza.
s_cat_desc_actions.en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

s_cat_desc_clothing.ha: Mavazi. Somo hili linahusu nguo tunazovaa.
s_cat_desc_clothing.en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

s_cat_desc_people.ha: Watu. Somo hili linahusu watu wanaotuzunguka. Mama, baba, watoto na walimu.
s_cat_desc_people.en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

s_cat_desc_school.ha: Shule. Somo hili linahusu vitu tunavyotumia shuleni.
s_cat_desc_school.en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

s_cat_start_actions.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za vitendo. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
s_cat_start_actions.en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_clothing.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za nguo. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
s_cat_start_clothing.en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_people.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za watu. Tutajifunza majina yao kwa Kiingereza.
s_cat_start_people.en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_school.ha: Sasa tutaona picha za vitu vya shule. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.
s_cat_start_school.en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

s_ear.ha: Ili usikie tena, bonyeza sikio hili.
s_ear.en: To hear it again, press this ear.

s_go.en: Now press Laila and we'll start.

s_k_intro2.ha: Kusoma. Hapa tutasoma maneno, herufi baada ya herufi, kisha neno zima.
s_k_intro2.en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

s_k_lesson.ha: Sasa, tutasoma majina ya vitu hivi kwa Kiingereza.
s_k_lesson.en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

s_k_test.ha: Sasa tutafanya mtihani mdogo wa maneno uliyojifunza. Utaonyeshwa neno, kisha ulisome lote.
s_k_test.en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

s_kd_k3.ha: Maneno mafupi. Hapa tutasoma maneno mafupi, yenye herufi tatu.
s_kd_k3.en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

s_kd_k45.ha: Maneno ya wastani. Hapa tutasoma maneno yenye herufi nne na tano.
s_kd_k45.en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

s_kd_klong.ha: Maneno marefu. Hapa tutasoma maneno marefu.
s_kd_klong.en: Long words. Here we read long words.

s_kd_knum.ha: Namba. Hapa tutasoma majina ya namba kwa Kiingereza.
s_kd_knum.en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

s_l_check.ha: Sasa tutafanya mtihani mdogo, ili tuhakikishe umezielewa herufi ulizojifunza.
s_l_check.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

s_l_final1.ha: Mtihani mkubwa. Sema herufi zote, moja baada ya nyingine.
s_l_final1.en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

s_l_final2.ha: Mtihani wa mwisho. Herufi zitaonyeshwa zikiwa zimechanganywa, nawe uzitaje zote.
s_l_final2.en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

s_l_look.ha: Hizi hapa ni herufi nne. Sikiliza na utazame.
s_l_look.en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

s_l_new2.ha: Sasa utaona herufi mbili mpya za kujifunza. Hii ni hatua mpya, muhimu sana.
s_l_new2.en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new4.ha: Sasa utaona herufi nne mpya za kujifunza. Hii ni hatua mpya, muhimu sana.
s_l_new4.en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_laila2.ha: Jina langu ni Laila. Mimi ni rafiki yako wa kujifunza. Sasa, bonyeza kichwa changu tuanze.
s_laila2.en: My name is Laila. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

s_leave.ha: Kipindi kitaisha. Kama umemaliza, bonyeza Laila. Kama sivyo, bonyeza ubao mweusi.
s_leave.en: The session will end. If you are done, press Laila. If not, press the black slate.

s_loading.ha: Tafadhali subiri kidogo. Kila kitu kinaandaliwa.
s_loading.en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

s_n_big.ha: Sasa, mtihani mkubwa! Tutapima namba zote ulizojifunza, ili tuhakikishe unazijua. Utaonyeshwa namba, jina lake litatajwa kwa Kiswahili, nawe utaje jina lake kwa Kiingereza. Kama umesahau jina lake la Kiingereza,
s_n_big.en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Swahili, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_n_focus5.ha: Sasa tutajifunza tena zile zilizokuwa ngumu kwako, pamoja na chache unazozijua, ili tufanye mazoezi zaidi.
s_n_focus5.en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

s_n_hundreds.ha: Sasa mamia: mia mbili, mia tatu, hadi mia tisa, kisha elfu moja.
s_n_hundreds.en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

s_n_intro.ha: Hapa tutajifunza namba. Kwanza, tutahesabu kwa vidole, kutoka moja hadi kumi. Kisha tutajifunza alama za namba.
s_n_intro.en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

s_n_palms.ha: Huu hapa ni mkono. Hesabu vidole vilivyoinuliwa.
s_n_palms.en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

s_n_sym2.ha: Sasa alama za namba kutoka kumi na moja hadi ishirini.
s_n_sym2.en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

s_n_symbols.ha: Sasa tutajifunza alama za namba ulizojifunza, kutoka moja hadi kumi.
s_n_symbols.en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

s_n_tens.ha: Sasa tutajifunza namba kubwa: thelathini, arobaini, hamsini, hadi mia moja.
s_n_tens.en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

s_o_again2.en: Listen again. In English, it is:

s_o_allright.en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

s_o_focus_m.ha: Picha utakazoziona sasa ni zile zilizokuwa ngumu kwako. Tutazijifunza tena.
s_o_focus_m.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus_f.ha: Picha utakazoziona sasa ni zile zilizokuwa ngumu kwako. Tutazijifunza tena.
s_o_focus_f.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_look.ha: Hizi hapa ni picha. Sikiliza na utazame.
s_o_look.en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

s_o_miss.en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

s_o_new3.ha: Sasa, hizi hapa ni picha nyingine tano.
s_o_new3.en: Now here are five more pictures.

s_o_retake.ha: Baadhi hazikuwa sahihi. Tutazijifunza tena, kisha tufanye mtihani tena.
s_o_retake.en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

s_o_right.en: Here are the ones you got right:

s_o_test2.ha: Sasa tutafanya mtihani mdogo, ili tuhakikishe unazijua. Utaonyeshwa picha, jina lake litatajwa kwa Kiswahili, nawe utaje jina lake kwa Kiingereza. Kama umesahau jina lake la Kiingereza,
s_o_test2.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Swahili, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_o_three.ha: Hiyo ni ngumu. Sasa, tuendelee na inayofuata.
s_o_three.en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

s_o_turn.ha: Zamu yako. Bonyeza Laila, kisha taja jina lake kwa Kiingereza.
s_o_turn.en: Your turn. Press Laila and say its name in English.

s_p1_m.ha: Tutachukua video yako ukitaja jina lako. Kwa mfano, kama jina lako ni Musa, sema: Jina langu ni Musa.
s_p1_m.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Musa, say: Sunana Musa.

s_p1_f.ha: Tutachukua video yako ukitaja jina lako. Kwa mfano, kama jina lako ni Aisha, sema: Jina langu ni Aisha.
s_p1_f.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Musa, say: Sunana Musa.

s_p2.ha: Huyu hapa ni mvulana anayeitwa Musa. Anataja jina lake.
s_p2.en: Here is the boy Musa / the girl Aisha, saying the name.

s_p2_f.ha: Huyu hapa ni msichana anayeitwa Aisha. Anataja jina lake.
s_p2_f.en: Here is the boy Musa / the girl Aisha, saying the name.

s_p3.ha: Sasa wewe, tuambie jina lako. Bonyeza Laila, kisha utuambie jina lako.
s_p3.en: Now you: press Laila, then say your name.

s_perm.ha: Tunahitaji kamera na maikrofoni ili hii ifanye kazi. Bonyeza 'Allow'.
s_perm.en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

s_perm_no.ha: Ruhusa haikutolewa. Jaribu tena, kisha bonyeza 'Allow'.
s_perm_no.en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

s_q_again.ha: Sasa tucheze tena, na nyingine mpya. Sikiliza kwa makini.
s_q_again.en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

s_qd_q4.ha: Picha nne. Utaona picha nne, moja itatajwa kwa Kiingereza, nawe uibonyeze.
s_qd_q4.en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

s_qd_qnum.ha: Namba. Namba itatajwa kwa Kiingereza, nawe ubonyeze alama yake.
s_qd_qnum.en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

s_qn_tap.en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

s_r_intro2.ha: Hapa tutajifunza kuandika majina ya vitu kwa Kiingereza, herufi kwa herufi. Utaonyeshwa picha, nawe uandike jina lake.
s_r_intro2.en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

s_rd_r3.ha: Herufi tatu. Hapa tutaandika maneno yenye herufi tatu, herufi kwa herufi.
s_rd_r3.en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r4.ha: Herufi nne. Hapa tutaandika maneno yenye herufi nne, herufi kwa herufi.
s_rd_r4.en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r5.ha: Herufi tano. Hapa tutaandika maneno yenye herufi tano, herufi kwa herufi.
s_rd_r5.en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rlong.ha: Maneno marefu. Hapa tutaandika maneno marefu, herufi kwa herufi.
s_rd_rlong.en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rnum.ha: Namba. Hapa tutaandika majina ya namba kwa Kiingereza, herufi kwa herufi.
s_rd_rnum.en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

s_retry_face.en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_name.ha: Sikusikia vizuri ukitaja jina lako. Tafadhali, tujaribu tena.
s_retry_name.en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_door.ha: Au bonyeza mlango huu, urudi mwanzo na kuanza upya.
s_retry_door.en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

sx_intro.ha: Mfano! Tazama na usikilize jinsi inavyofanywa.
sx_intro.en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

sx_k_letters.ha: Nitasoma herufi, moja baada ya nyingine. Sikiliza.
sx_k_letters.en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

s_w_name.ha: Jina langu ni Laila. Mimi ni rafiki yako wa kujifunza.
s_w_name.en: My name is Laila. I am your learning friend.

s_w_together.en: Together we are going to learn English.

s_w_l1.en: We will learn the English alphabet.

s_w_l2.ha: Tutajifunza kusoma na kuandika kwa Kiingereza.
s_w_l2.en: We will learn to read and write in English.

s_w_l4.ha: Tutajifunza majina ya vitu kama wanyama na vyakula, kwa Kiingereza.
s_w_l4.en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

s_w_more.ha: Na mambo mengine mengi ya kusisimua.

s_w_talk.ha: Utaweza kuzungumza nami, nami nitakuwa pamoja nawe.
s_w_talk.en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

s_b_glad.en: I am happy to see you.

s_b_cont.en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

sx_do_say.ha: Hivi ndivyo utakavyofanya ili kusema kwa Kiingereza. Utabonyeza Laila, kisha utasema:
sx_do_say.en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say:

sx_do_read.ha: Hivi ndivyo utakavyofanya ili kusoma kwa Kiingereza. Utabonyeza Laila, kisha utasoma neno:
sx_do_read.en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Laila, then you will read the word:

sx_do_spell.ha: Hivi ndivyo utakavyofanya ili kuandika kwa Kiingereza. Utabonyeza Laila, kisha utataja herufi:
sx_do_spell.en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say the letters:

sx_do_find.ha: Hivi ndivyo utakavyofanya. Sikiliza, kisha bonyeza picha iliyotajwa.
sx_do_find.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

sx_do_findnum.ha: Hivi ndivyo utakavyofanya. Sikiliza, kisha bonyeza namba iliyotajwa.
sx_do_findnum.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

s_q_start.ha: Sasa, utaonyeshwa picha nne. Sikiliza jina litakalotajwa kwa Kiingereza, kisha uibonyeze picha hiyo.
s_q_start.en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

s_qn_start.ha: Sasa, utaonyeshwa namba. Sikiliza ile itakayotajwa kwa Kiingereza, kisha uibonyeze.
s_qn_start.en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

sx_r_plan.ha: Tutataja herufi moja baada ya nyingine. Kuna njia mbili.
sx_r_plan.en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

sx_r_v1.ha: Herufi ya kwanza, nitaitaja kwa sauti.
sx_r_v1.en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_v2.ha: Herufi ya pili pia, nitaitaja kwa sauti.
sx_r_v2.en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_kb.ha: Na herufi ya mwisho, nitaibonyeza kwenye ubao.
sx_r_kb.en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

s_pop_intro.ha: Haya hapa ni maputo yenye herufi. Bonyeza puto kwa kidole chako, nalo litapasuka.
s_pop_intro.en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

s_pop_done.en: Well done, we've finished the game!

s_pop_demo.ha: Huu hapa ni mfano. Nitapasua la kwanza:
s_pop_demo.en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:

s_pop_task.ha: Tafuta herufi ya kwanza ya Kiingereza, uipasue. Kisha herufi inayofuata, kwa mpangilio.
s_pop_task.en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.
